title: Differential effects of γ-state-triggered thalamic stimulation on mechanical sensitivity in rats with neuropathic pain
title_zh: γ状态诱导的丘脑刺激对神经痛大鼠机械敏感度的不同效应
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To develop and evaluate a thalamic γ-state-triggered closed-loop (CL) deep brain stimulation (DBS) strategy for modulation of neuropathic pain. METHODS: Neuropathic pain was induced with chronic constriction injury (CCI) in rats. Thalamic local field potentials (LFPs) were used to identify wavelet-packet (WP)-defined gamma (γ)-band states, γ0 and γ1, using coefficient magnitudes relative to an adaptive threshold and temporal confirmation. A CL DBS paradigm triggered stimulation contingent on either γ0 or γ1 states and was compared with conventional open-loop (OL) 40 Hz and 130 Hz stimulation using behavioral and neurophysiological outcomes. RESULTS: CCI increased thalamic γ power on days 3, 7 and 14 (raw p = 0.0004, 0.0078 and 0.0162; FDR-adjusted p = 0.0077, 0.0703 and 0.0731) and prolonged γ1-state duration (raw p = 0.0283; adjusted p = 0.1417). In the CCI model, γ power was negatively associated with mechanical withdrawal threshold (MWT; raw p = 0.0159; adjusted p = 0.0956). At 130 Hz, mean MWT changes were opposite under the two CL protocols: γ0 CL increased MWT by 47.07% and γ1 CL decreased it by 12.06% (raw p = 0.0234 and 0.0391; adjusted p = 0.0469 and 0.0586). The 40 Hz γ0 CL protocol produced the largest observed mean MWT increase of 81.91% (raw p = 0.0078; adjusted p = 0.0469), 46.02 percentage points above 40 Hz OL. Electrophysiological analyses also showed protocol-associated changes in γ-state dynamics and nominal spectral-power changes. CONCLUSION: The tested WP-defined γ-state-triggered CL protocols were associated with differing changes in mechanical sensitivity in neuropathic rats. These findings support further evaluation of this approach as a candidate framework for adaptive neuromodulation of neuropathic pain.
abstract_zh: 目的：开发并评估一种丘脑γ状态诱导的闭环（CL）深部脑刺激（DBS）策略，用于调节神经痛。方法：在大鼠中使用慢性束缚损伤（CCI）诱导神经痛。利用丘脑局部场电位（LFP）识别小波包（WP）定义的γ（γ）带状态γ0和γ1，基于相对于自适应阈值的系数大小和时间确认。采用γ0或γ1状态触发刺激的CL DBS范式，并与常规开环（OL）40 Hz和130 Hz刺激进行行为和神经生理学结果比较。结果：CCI在第3、7和14天增加了丘脑γ功率（原始p=0.0004、0.0078和0.0162；FDR校正p=0.0077、0.0703和0.0731）并延长了γ1状态持续时间（原始p=0.0283；调整后p=0.1417）。在CCI模型中，γ功率与机械撤退阈值（MWT）呈负相关（原始p=0.0159；调整后p=0.0956）。在130 Hz下，两种CL协议下的MWT均方变化相反：γ0 CL使MWT增加47.07%，γ1 CL使其减少12.06%（原始p=0.0234和0.0391；调整后p=0.0469和0.0586）。40 Hz γ0 CL协议产生了观察到的最大均方MWT增加81.91%（原始p=0.0078；调整后p=0.0469），比40 Hz OL高46.02个百分点。电生理分析还显示了协议相关的γ状态动力学变化和名义光谱功率变化。结论：测试的WP定义γ状态诱导的CL协议与神经痛大鼠机械敏感度的不同变化相关。这些发现进一步支持将此方法评估为自适应神经调控神经痛的候选框架。
